title: Compliance evidence runlist — personal log
content:
Quick personal runlist and scratchnotes for the week — trying to collapse all the tiny follow-ups into one place. Not a polished handoff, just my head-space while I clear a few SOC2 evidence gaps and the LogShip vendor review.

Priority overview (rough):
- P0: finish control A.3 evidence package for infra encryption-at-rest (KMS rotate proof, backup attestations).
- P1: vendor questionnaire for LogShip (security + data flow diagram), get review from Maya.
- P1: map quarterly access reviews (admins list) to evidence artifacts in Confluence.
- P2: policy TODOs: update Acceptable Use to include new hosted-api telemetry retention clause.

Today (2026-05-02) quick actions:
- [x] Export KMS rotation audit logs for March–April (found in S3: s3://redwood-sec-audit/kms-rotations/).
- [ ] Attach signed backup receipts from StorageOps to control A.3 folder (Confluence page: Evidence Map v2).
- [ ] Finish LogShip SAQ draft: answers for Q3, Q7 (encryption in transit), Q12 (subprocessor list).
- [ ] Ping Priya for confirmation on SLA excerpt we can include in evidence bundle (need exact clause text).
- [ ] Run quick grep on infra repo for any PRs that changed KMS config in last 6 months (GH PRs: review infra/pull/800–850).

Notes / snippets:
- Where I hide things while iterating: put working copies under /tmp/compliance-work/<date>-<owner> on my laptop, final artifacts go into Confluence attachments. Remember to remove temp copies after handoff.
- Evidence naming convention reminder: yyyy-mm-dd_controlID_owner_description.pdf (keeps search easy).
- For LogShip, the vendor security contact is: security@logship.io (emailed 2026-04-28, awaiting revised subprocessor list).
- If LogShip returns SOC report, treat as supplemental — still need data flow diagram and contractual clause.

Outstanding blockers:
- StorageOps hasn't produced the signed backup manifest (file requested 2026-04-25).
- Legal needs to confirm redaction rules for customer identifiers before I upload a sample incident report.

Quick checklist to close a control (my personal minimal steps):
1) Locate canonical artifact (policy/receipt/PR).
2) Snapshot with context (screenshot or PDF export).
3) Add one-sentence comment explaining why this satisfies the control.
4) Link to Jira ticket or Confluence anchor.
5) Put final file in Evidence Map attachments and mark control as "evidence attached".

Small friction items to address later (notes to self):
- Make a little script to zip evidence by control ID and add manifest (maybe a GH action).
- Standardize the one-line evidence comment format so reviewers don't have to guess.
- Ask Platform Eng for a short README for where to find live KV cache retention logs — they're needed for control C.2.

Meeting prep for 2026-05-04 sync with Priya & Maya:
- 10 min: status by control (I'll take A.3, A.4, C.2).
- 10 min: vendor intake — LogShip outstanding items and timeline.
- 10 min: policy edits review (Acceptable Use, Data Retention).

Questions to bring up on call / Slack:
- Legal: can we include a redacted incident timeline as evidence, or do we need a synthesized statement? (PRIV-48?)
- Platform Eng: who owns the KV cache retention doc? (cc @tomas?)
- StorageOps: estimated delivery for backup manifest — escalate if not in 48h.

Micro-tasks I can finish today in <30m: 
- finalize the one-line evidence comments for the three KMS exports I already pulled.
- create JIRA subtask under SEC-789 for LogShip follow-up (assign to Maya).
- draft the short email template to vendors requesting subprocessor lists (so I don't rewrite it each time).

Random anchors I might copy into Confluence: 
- Evidence Map v2 > A.3 > KMS rotation proof: attach kms-rotations-march-april-2026.pdf
- Vendor intake > LogShip > SAQ-draft-2026-05-02.md

If I clear these, good candidate to mark this control batch as "in-review" and hand off for final sign-off.

-- end of runlist (for now).
